newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak c.bank drains SKK3.4bln in rev repo tenders.
newsitem.headline: Slovak c.bank drains SKK3.4bln in rev repo tenders.

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) said it drained funds totalling 3.406 billion crowns through two securities reverse repurchase tenders on Friday.
In the NBS's three-day reverse repo tender, the average rate rose to 17.3 percent, after 17.00 percent in the previous reverse repo tender of a similar maturity on Tuesday.
In a seven-day repo tender, the average rate rose to 17.26 percent from 16.74 percent on Thursday.
The NBS added the three-day tender was oversubscribed with 2.85 billion crowns worth of bids from a total of 3.05 billion being accepted.
All bids for the seven-day tender totalling 556 million crowns were accepted.
